scope: Existing explicitly referenced file entities. This reader enriches a supplied immutable reference; it does not enumerate repository files, parse their bodies or create another file identity.

authorities.role: Strict five-field immutable repository source locator and content identity.
Strict canonical entity envelope with open properties mapping.
Producer identity, surface, title, description, path and missing-reference flag.
Canonical path identity, index-first resolution, one node per unresolved referenced path and original present/missing observation.
Existing conversion to SourceFile/Test, pinned source hash, source locator and reference properties.
Immutable snapshot source boundary and exact-revision disclosure; current worktree is not source authority.

record_identity.input: One existing Entity with kind exactly SourceFile.
record_identity.native_id: The exact existing entity.canonical_id. For producer files-surface nodes this is the canonical repository-relative POSIX path, but do not replace canonical_id with source.path if an already-valid entity differs.
record_identity.locator: The exact existing entity.source.locator, including an empty string.
record_identity.title: The exact existing entity.title, even when empty or different from the file basename.
record_identity.description: The exact existing entity.summary, even when empty.
record_identity.metadata: A deep copy of the complete Entity field shape: canonical_id, kind, title, summary, source (all five SourceReference fields), and properties (all original property names and values). Keep provenance and properties nested to avoid colliding future property names with canonical envelope names.
record_identity.derived: Empty. Do not manufacture file extension, language, ownership, timestamps, sizes, content, status or existence facts.
record_identity.repeat_enrichment: Exclude only the three exact adapter-injected keys _native_projection, _native_identity and _native_source_path from the nested properties copy. Preserve all other original keys, including keys starting _native_ that are not these three. Never mutate the supplied Entity.
identity_rules: The graph producer strips #symbol or ::test suffixes before path identity; the stripped anchor belongs to the relationship, not a second file node or a fabricated node property.
Producer canonicalization changes separators and collapses relative segments before creating a file reference. This reader receives the final identity and must not normalize it again or case-fold it.
Index-first resolution can point a referenced path at an existing AC or Component node. Do not create a SourceFile record for those entities; enrich only entities whose kind is SourceFile.
A future canonical Document or Ticket for the same path has a different record identity and does not replace the established SourceFile reference.
Test is a distinct reference specialization and must be handled by its own reviewed reader. Do not classify by file suffix or parse test functions here.

fields.constraints: Non-empty; preserve original retrieval identity exactly.
Exactly SourceFile for this reader; reject other kinds explicitly.
Existing display title; empty is valid.
Preserve the already-materialized Entity value without parsing file contents.
Complete SourceReference object, without recomputation or replacement.
Exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters under the current SourceReference schema.
Non-empty repository-relative POSIX path; no absolute path, parent traversal, backslash or colon. Reject invalid references, do not repair them.
Preserve the exact source locator. Ordinary file nodes currently use an empty locator.
Preserve exactly; an empty hash is an allowed older/partial SourceReference value, not a request to read the current filesystem.
Open mapping. Preserve all existing original fields and nested values, apart from the exact three projection-internal exclusions specified above.
Present in canonical_loader output; preserve absence in older manually constructed Entity payloads rather than defaulting.

fields.producer_value: The negation of path.exists() at original source projection time.
fields.constraints: Explicit true, explicit false and absent are distinct metadata states. Do not recheck against a later or dirty checkout.
False for files-surface references. This marks record authority, not whether the referenced file exists.
False for ordinary file references. Preserve exact original value and presence rather than computing it from path.

missing_and_hash_semantics: The original files node uses path.exists(), while canonical_loader hashes path.read_bytes() only when path.is_file(); otherwise it hashes b''. Therefore missing files currently have the SHA-256 of empty bytes rather than an absent hash.
An existing empty regular file also has the SHA-256 of empty bytes. A hash alone cannot distinguish it from a missing reference; retain the explicit missing flag.

A referenced directory may have missing=false but the empty-byte hash because the original producer uses exists() and the loader uses is_file(). Do not silently reinterpret it as missing or read its contents.
A reference that was missing in its pinned generation must remain present as a graph reference node even if a file appears later in the active worktree.
A reference that was present must retain its pinned hash and missing=false even if the supplied root now lacks that file. This reader has no authority to replace historical evidence.
Hash verification/recomputation belongs to the canonical source loader or a separately governed pinned-source audit. The from_entity reader needs no filesystem access and must not parse file bodies.
null_empty_absent_semantics: Entity and SourceReference are already materialized contracts; retain their declared fields including empty summary, locator and content_hash strings and empty properties object.
Do not infer authored absence for model-defaulted envelope fields. SourceFile is a reference contract, not frontmatter with an authoring history.
Inside properties, absent keys, explicit null, empty string, empty array and empty object remain distinct. Unknown future scalar, list and object properties must survive.
Keep list ordering and nested-object association. Metadata projection uses escaped JSON Pointer leaves and shape metadata for nulls and empty containers.
Deep-copy nested properties so caller mutation after enrichment cannot alter the source entity or the generated NativeRecord.

native_property_exposure.reference_fields: Expose the complete metadata field tree, including /source/repository_id, /source/source_sha, /source/path, /source/locator, /source/content_hash and /properties/missing.
native_property_exposure.ordinary_flags: The coordinator's display_properties currently already copies simple original Entity.properties to ordinary Neo4j properties, so surface, missing, canonical and registry_identity remain directly filterable. This reader's nested metadata supplies a lossless independently reconstructable reference contract.
native_property_exposure.collisions: Do not merge properties into the reference envelope: a future properties.title or properties.source must remain distinct from Entity.title or Entity.source.
native_property_exposure.relationships: Do not derive new component ownership, file-to-file edges or anchors. Preserve the snapshot's existing relationships unchanged.

algorithm: Require an Entity with kind SourceFile and validate its reference shape/path without opening referenced files. root is part of the common integration signature, not authority to refresh pinned facts.
Deep-copy the complete reference envelope using Python-mode values. Strip only the three exact adapter-injected properties used for prior enrichment.

Return NativeRecord(kind='SourceFile', native_id=entity.canonical_id, source_path=entity.source.path, locator=entity.source.locator, title=entity.title, description=entity.summary, metadata=reference_copy, derived={}).
Do not add extract(root), repository traversal, source-body parsing or filesystem existence/hash observation.
Do not rewrite the supplied Entity or change its source, identity, flag values or relationships. Let the coordinator apply the presentation metadata to the same entity.
acceptance_checks: Present reference preserves all six Entity fields and all five source fields, including a custom title/summary and locator.
Missing reference remains a returned SourceFile with missing=true and its exact original empty-byte hash, even when the referenced file now exists under root.
Present reference remains missing=false with the old hash even when root does not contain its file; no filesystem read is attempted.
An empty original content_hash stays empty; the reader does not fill it.
Absent missing/canonical flags remain absent; explicit false, null and empty structures survive unmodified.
Future properties with nested lists, nulls and envelope-colliding names survive deep-copy and native-properties encode/decode round-trip.
Canonical ID distinct from source.path and empty title/summary are preserved rather than replaced with basename defaults.
Test, Component, Document and other entity kinds are rejected explicitly.
Invalid out-of-root or platform-specific source paths fail explicitly without filesystem access.
Repeat enrichment strips the exact projection-internal keys only, avoiding recursive growth while retaining an unrelated future _native_ prefixed source property.
Mutating nested metadata cannot mutate the original entity; changing original nested properties cannot retroactively mutate the record.

count_basis: No new source enumeration performed. SourceFile count is exactly the number of supplied existing SourceFile entities in the caller's immutable snapshot.
